name: Harness Pulse
author: Fred Nix
description: One ring per coding agent on every linked Harness machine. Working sweeps, waiting breathes toward you, permission asks in red, done fills to a dot, failed flashes twice then holds. Reads the local Harness daemon's attention feed; nothing leaves the machine.

barWidget.description: Agent attention rings for OpenHarness: which agent is working, which one is waiting on you, which one finished.
